needs_review.finding: Multiple records use hex ID or UUID slugs (e.g., CEFDA0, F5A4C7, 3ebb27, 88883698-F2F4-4F68-9501-BBE6B51CE18F). Per template rule, these are graded 'medium' confidence because the URL does not tie the page to the named person—only the title does.
needs_review.evidence: Brief explicitly states: opaque hex IDs are 'medium, always. The URL does not tie the page to the name.' Examples from brief: CEFDA0 (David & Fran Wakefield), A18F31 (Brad and Toni Guderian).
needs_review.recommendation: All hex/UUID slug records graded 'medium' per policy. If downstream processing requires higher confidence, surnames must be verified from independent sources, but this would violate the protection rule for sensitive regions.

needs_review.finding: Andrew & Sophia Pitcher page uses slug 'hamelitz' which carries a different surname. Title clearly names Pitcher. Graded 'high' because title resolves the couple fully.
needs_review.evidence: URL: wycliffe.org/partner/hamelitz. Title: 'Andrew & Sophia Pitcher'. Slug does not carry their name.
needs_review.recommendation: Record retained as high confidence because title is authoritative and unambiguous. Slug mismatch noted in fit_reason.

needs_review.issue: Vanity slugs with first names only (zakandlaura)
needs_review.finding: Zak & Laura O'Leary use first-names-only slug 'zakandlaura'. Surname not in URL. Graded 'high' because: (1) vanity URL is clearly their own property, (2) title names them fully as O'Learys.
needs_review.evidence: URL: wycliffe.org/partner/zakandlaura. Title: 'Zak & Laura O'Leary'. This matches the brief example, graded high.
needs_review.recommendation: High confidence appropriate per brief guidance: 'That is the inverse of the usual case. Grade it high — the slug is that couple's own vanity URL and the title names them in full.'

needs_review.issue: Greg & Mary Ellen Schrock: dual slug entries
needs_review.finding: Same couple appears with two different slug formats: wycliffe.org/partner/4ED23C (hex ID) and wycliffe.org/partner/schrock (surname). Emitted once under surname slug (higher confidence), recorded here to avoid duplication noise.
needs_review.evidence: Search 1 found 4ED23C; Search 13 found schrock. Both title as 'Greg & Mary Ellen Schrock'. Same people, two URLs.
needs_review.recommendation: Only one record emitted (under 'schrock' URL, graded high). Hex variant noted but not split.
